events.before: uint64 decimal sequence, exclusive, current generation

http_status.200: Read, existing retry or receipt result
http_status.202: Start/control accepted, not delivered or started
http_status.404: Unknown or invisible target, no existence leak
http_status.409: Stale binding/revision/controller, replay conflict, unconfirmed writer or expired cursor
http_status.429: Bounded capacity/backpressure; no silent drop for writes
http_status.503: Native feature/qualification unavailable or drain refusal; reason code is allowlisted

headers.controller: X-Aeon-Attach-Capability on commands; derived short-lived session/actor/client/epoch-bound capability; never in URLs, events or raw history
headers.step_up: Existing Aeon-Step-Up/phone confirmation mechanism, bound to exact effect; no new vendor credentials
headers.cache: Cache-Control: no-store on all native/Expert/capability routes
headers.version: New public DTOs use the header, never add a version body field
headers.viewer: X-Aeon-Viewer-ID: nonsecret viewer UUID from attach; actor/peer, scope, consent and expiry are independently checked. Browser fetch-SSE uses headers and current authenticated session.
headers.local_protocol: X-Aeon-Session-Protocol: aeon-native-session/1 on every local request/response, including GET streams; POST envelope protocol must agree.

receipt_semantics: accepted/queued are application intent only; write_started is journaled before native I/O.
write_acknowledged requires adapter-native write ack; turn_started requires the exact consumed input/native turn reference.
delivered/read on existing chat/inbox APIs keep their existing definitions; no global enum rewrite. Map native evidence conservatively, never fetching/queueing to delivered.
turn_completed/final persisted do not imply process exit. stop succeeds only with observed root/group exit evidence under current provenance.
Crash between native I/O and correlated receipt is uncertain; never automatically resend the input. Stable request IDs reject changed payload/actor as replay conflict.
Final replay stores only approved explicit final answers, stable IDs and classified retention; not assembled token chunks or private reasoning.

A final retained under an old harness generation needs an exact server-issued drain-only final authorization or accepted same-conversation transfer; no current-binding bypass. Without authority it is rejected/expired visibly.
state_transitions: idle/running -> quiescing -> confirmed structured exit -> fresh terminal runtime epoch/harness generation -> taken
taken -> returning -> confirmed PTY exit -> fresh qualified structured successor -> idle
Any uncertain possible fork/write/exit -> ownership_lost/recovering; hold slot, reject second writer and expire live callbacks.
Stop -> stopping -> stopped only on exit_confirmed; unknown exit stays ownership_lost, never guessed stopped.
Detach affects only view/controller; no process lifetime transition.

stream_rules.dispatch: kind determines exactly one payload schema; validators reject mismatched kind/shape even though JSON Schema oneOf alone is insufficient.
stream_rules.ready: First SSE event is snapshot with current mode/binding/receipt/capabilities; ready is not delivery evidence.
stream_rules.events: SSE event name equals kind; Last-Event-ID is <generation>:<seq>. Still independently scoped by authenticated actor, tenant, session, viewer grant and exact binding; an event ID is never authority.
stream_rules.replay: Generation increments for every fresh runtime including resume/restart/take/return. seq is gapless within generation and equals sequence. GET events?before=<seq>&limit=N defaults to 200, max 500; gaps and retention are explicit. Raw Expert/PTY remain RAM-only; approved explicit finals use existing authorized chat retention.
stream_rules.expert: Native envelope names/structure after field allowlisting, credential/redaction filters and size check. No reasoning, arbitrary tool inputs/results, auth/config paths, tokens or login payloads. Unknown frames produce omitted metadata, not arbitrary JSON passthrough.
stream_rules.terminal: PTY output is opt-in owner live view, RAM only, read-only. Disable OSC52/device replies/input/paste handlers. Auth/login PTYs are not exported. Unqualified unsafe screen export stays unavailable; redaction is not a claim of filesystem isolation.
stream_rules.authorization: Every frame plus keepalive revalidates current target/owner/view permission and consent; revocation cancels queued output and closes viewer.
stream_rules.boundaries: All events use actual current native reader correlation; client/provider-supplied public IDs never confer authority.

events.privacy: Content-free audit/state changes only, current target visibility and owner-only metadata filtering. Append through existing events log under event counter last; event-log seq differs from transient source seq.

final_drain_rules: Issued on the existing authorized runtime claim, scoped to one exact runtime/conversation/binding and approved 24 h maximum retention window. Native context grant expiry still applies; no renewable authority by merely retrying.

The claim_kind final_drain may reissue the SAME unexpired publication grant to the current authenticated paired-computer principal after daemon restart and exact metadata proof. It never returns launch/control authority or invents an exit.
The final endpoint uses existing chat-isolated final-message storage through a narrow transaction helper, stable final_id and content hash; same ID with different text/actor/turn is 409.
Completed explicit final and input/native-turn evidence must already match the qualified owned runtime. No token assembly, arbitrary transcript import, new vendor credentials or permissions.

Native process exit/archival does not itself erase an unexpired drain grant, but revocation, target permission loss, consent/retention withdrawal and expiry refuse persistence visibly. General chat/legacy final route semantics stay unchanged.
conditional_validation: Bounds on text/frame/base64 are bytes as well as schema character limits, enforced before decode/allocation. sequence strings are at most uint64 max.
Worker start requires non-null leaf work_id and valid parent generation; coordinator requires a person-owned project grant. Start role cannot select authority by label.
stop.force requires non-null force_authorization_id and existing current person confirmation/step-up; graceful requires null.
approval answer is non-null only for decision answer; allow_once/deny require null. Effect/request/runtime/turn must all match.
Stream event kind selects exactly one mapped payload. Body binding, route ownedSessionId and authenticated proof must agree.

Terminal is available only in taken mode. Native web v1 remains read-only for PTY; take/return HTTP schemas are reserved but remote take stays unsupported until explicit local-controller handoff qualification. Capability take is false for web callers in v1.
NativeLocalStart after_exit requires a current pinned source-process/native-session identity; raw pid is never signal authority, and pid reuse cannot satisfy or reset its barrier.
Start/resume may not proceed with any live or uncertain writer for the native conversation/account/workspace. Admission observes both server and local shared ledger.
A final_drain claim has launch_authorized=false and never produces start/resume/control authority; Host.Start requires a still-current explicit launch-authorized claim.

Private report/publish/final routes require non-null exact binding and matched current paired-computer or final-drain authority; nullable receipt binding is only for application start intent before a runtime is allocated.

Subscribe requires X-Aeon-Viewer-ID returned by attach plus authenticated actor/peer and unexpired exact view grant. It carries no capability in the URL; fetch-SSE supports headers. Control commands additionally require X-Aeon-Attach-Capability.

Native-TUI takeover is unavailable unless its OS/tool/settings/permission fence enforces the same immutable approved scope; an SDK canUseTool callback alone cannot qualify a replacement TUI. No native permission bypass is inferred from current unmanaged launch flags.

LaunchConfig is server-resolved from the current approved model/profile and grant; its digests must equal NativePolicy. Provider-specific approval/sandbox/setting mappings are compiled, pin-qualified by the exact policy digest, not user-supplied argv or guessed universal vendor enums.

claim_kind command requires command and command_actor non-null and launch_authorized=false; start/resume require command=null and a current launch_authorized claim. final_drain requires command=null and unexpired final_drain_grant.
Root reservation count is separate from worker run count. NativeBinding.run_id is null for coordinator roots, non-null for existing worker run context; no fake leaf run is created.

expert_projection_allowlist.rule: Parse <=1 MiB, depth <=16; event-specific allowlist keeps the native envelope/casing. Unknown fields/subtypes/blocks are omitted. Source connection must match NativeBinding. Server revalidates the same export before broadcasting.

claude.content: Only assistant text blocks and stream text_delta text enter the live view under the existing explicit output policy. thinking/redacted_thinking/tool_use input/tool_result blocks are omitted. Final result text publishes through final endpoint, not raw durable replay.
claude.identity: Native session/task/message/turn ids are replaced with domain-separated opaque refs; record every replacement in redacted_paths.

codex.content: Only already-qualified agentMessage text/delta, bounded token-use/rate-limit measurements and approval/request metadata allowed. command/output/env/file-diff/tool argument/result bodies are excluded. Event method set is the pinned native codec fixture, not arbitrary method text accepted by clients.
codex.identity: Thread/turn/item ids become domain-separated opaque refs; native source correlation is retained locally for receipts.

expert_projection_allowlist.other: ACP/Pi export native envelope plus qualified event/session/status/id metadata only until P5b registers tested provider-specific text projection. No arbitrary tool payload export.
expert_projection_allowlist.limits: More than 64 redacted paths, invalid native shape or any unsafe export emits omitted=true with safe event name/byte count and no raw body. No truncation disguises an original complete frame.

command_delivery_rules: Public input/control endpoints persist only their authorized intent/receipt; input body uses existing permitted inbox/chat storage, nonpersistent controls use bounded ephemeral payload storage. No direct web-to-native I/O occurs in a database transaction.

Agentd lists metadata-only pending commands, then claims exactly one with claim_kind=command and operation_id. Final claim rechecks the original command actor/owner grant, current target permissions, controller/effect/step-up and exact runtime under the access-change fence. Policy and account binding cannot change.

The claim result contains exactly one NativeDaemonCommand and its immutable command_actor. command/start/resume/final_drain variants cannot borrow each other authority; launch_authorized is true only for actual start/resume. Nonpersistent payload lost on API restart is rejected, not reconstructed.

Only never-written, unexpired commands with no possible native I/O may be claimed again. Once write_started is journaled, loss of ack is uncertain and forbids automatic reinjection. At native completion agentd reports the correlated receipt idempotently.

Claim authorization_ttl_ms, attach expires_in_ms and approval expires_in_ms are server/DB-derived durations. The client subtracts elapsed monotonic request time and binds a monotonic deadline; expires_at is display/audit only. Recheck deadline and exact ownership under the final native write/signal lock.

Queued after-turn input is claimed only when the target boundary is ready, and revalidated then; an expired controller/grant/input is rejected rather than silently renewing its authority. Waiting does not consume a native write claim.
Private final publication uses only its final-drain claim, never NativeDaemonCommand launch/control authority. Unsupported remote take is rejected before queueing in v1.
root_reservation_rules: Workers use their existing leaf agent_runs reservation and expose its run_id; coordinator run_id is null and must never invent a leaf work item to satisfy ordinary run machinery.

P1b adds native root account/host reservation metadata in migration 1344; it is held before possible fork, counted across current server start/engine/routine/account/host admission and the existing local shared ledger, and released only on verified no-fork abandonment or confirmed owned exit.
Native root hold states include queued/starting/running/idle/taken/exit_unconfirmed. Idle, API outage, turn completion, viewer detach and old daemon generation never free the slot.

I1 wires minimal server occupancy reads before G_P1_LIVE. Existing AEON-1251 account-backed-run predicates remain unchanged; count native sidecar reservations only where run_id IS NULL, preventing worker double-count.
P4c later extends profile/quota/rebind behavior, not the initial root occupancy safety. An approved root concurrency/account plan is a live prerequisite; profile-native never creates free capacity.

Root managed input/control/final context uses exact native binding/grant plus paired principal/epoch. Do not force a root into ordinary run-only chat/control validation or weaken legacy lease checks to make it fit.

c0_refinements.source: c0-inputs.md, LEAD 2026-10-13 00:20; supersedes older cursor/lease details without changing existing APIs
c0_refinements.generation: New integer session generation; never overload runtime_epoch, harness_session_id or daemon_generation. seq/sequence are identical uint64 decimal strings.
c0_refinements.text: assistant.delta keyed by message_id; assistant.final contains full approved explicit final text. input_id is vendor-correlated when available; otherwise the first final after delivery sets inferred=true. A delta assembly is never final evidence.
c0_refinements.tools: tool.start and tool.result pair by call_id. Only bounded privacy-approved args/result summaries; never raw tool bodies.
c0_refinements.input: input.delivered from is a principal projection; level immediate|next_step. not_confirmed and generation_changed are retryable; session_ended and refused are final. Manual retry requires honest receipt/ownership checks; uncertainty never permits automatic reinjection.
c0_refinements.take: Structured stream pauses in v1 with one stream.paused row while the person drives the TUI. Transcript source is reserved for separately qualified v2 and rejected in v1. No force-take.
c0_refinements.lease: Server authority, 5-second heartbeat and 30-second grace; unreachable host/holder expires lease and emits control.lease_expired. Lease expiry never implies native writer exit. CLI take may hold control while web stays read-only.
c0_refinements.pty: Holder size wins; viewers letterbox and never resize or send PTY input. All PTY stream/viewer URL access is server-side person-only; terminal view is absent from agent API.
c0_refinements.capabilities: Session capabilities expose take_supported, events_supported, interrupt_supported, chat_supported; UI renders only advertised support. take/interrupt/input aliases must agree. Web v1 take remains false.
c0_refinements.end_control: POST /api/sessions/{id}/control/end for person owner/project admin. Notify holder; emit control.ended_by; never skip the native writer exit barrier.
c0_refinements.terms: Workspace owner uses their own vendor accounts; no pooled/shared credentials or intermediate claude.ai tokens; vendor binary remains unmodified. Tenant enablement needs BYO API or vendor-approved flow.
